name: ZX_EXCEPTIONS
description: This table stores tax rate exceptions for items and product fiscal classifications, which are conditions that result in a change from the standard values for a particular product. Each row specifies the percentage of original tax rate to be treated as an exception for an item or a product fiscal classification during tax calculation.

columns.name: TAX_EXCEPTION_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for the exception rate

columns.name: EXCEPTION_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the exception class. Possible values are ITEM and PRODUCTFC

columns.name: EXCEPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the exception type. Possible values are DISCOUNT and SPECIAL_RATE.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this exception

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for this exception

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for this exception

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code for this exception

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of this exception

columns.name: EXCEPTION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates reason for this exception

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Inventory Item for which this exception applies

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Inventory organization identifier for the item

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Product fiscal classification type code for this exception

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Product fiscal classification code for which this exception applies

columns.name: RATE_MODIFIER
columns.description: Percentage of the original tax rate that is treated as an exception

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier for this exception

columns.name: DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template code for this exception

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of this record by a concurrent program

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
